what: Text · titles linger half transparent (.5) and blurred 10px (4.4%), then sharpen at once like a heartbeat (8%), blur slightly again (.92 · blur 2px, 11.5%), and slowly settle — 2.26s, .15s apart per piece. Plays once when it comes 20% in past the bottom 10% of the screen (with on: load, once after the delay as soon as it is attached).
ease: Per segment: linear → cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) → cubic-bezier(.37,0,.63,1) → cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)

options.delay: Start delay (seconds), default 0 — on the original hero, .6 after the font loads
options.on: With load, right as it attaches, without it, when it enters the screen (10% from the bottom, 20% from the top)
options.[data-fx-part=beat]: Pieces that jump in turn — if none, the element itself jumps

from.where: /  shared.js PULSE (original data-pulse-cardio — section head English·one line, Hero title 600ms after the font + 150ms intervals)
